punchline: Share until it hurts, then share some more.
thirty_sec: According to McChrystal and his co-authors, in 2004 the special operations task force in Iraq began sharing information widely; the daily video update, once limited to senior leaders, was at times joined by thousands.
question: Who on your team needs to make a decision this week and still has not seen the information that decision rests on?
key_contrast: One shared picture instead of need-to-know.
